about: anidoodle's own review record for launchExampleClean, the worked example of the launch template. Written by fresh critics (agents) over two rounds, not a person's review. A film made from the template gets its own record, written for that film (references/workflows/review.md).
verdict: ship (builder agent, template r3): no open P0 or P1; every P2 from critics r1 and r2 fixed and the film re-shipped PASS on 16:9 and 9:16

findings.note: Fixed (template r3): the end card no longer holds still. As its last part lands the page settles in 3 % about the dot on an out-cubic, and the install line is fully on for more than 3 s of it.
findings.by: fresh critic r1, rechecked by r2 (agents); fixed in template r3, checked by the builder agent

findings.note: Words sink at frames 910 to 935, and the headline is fully gone before the dot travels and the bloom opens at 960 to 984. Nothing is cut mid-word.
Copy now reads 'Month end, one click.' (frames 560 to 700), and the cursor click on Close month at 596 agrees with the words.

The bloom is now the loudest moment: momentary -10.5 LUFS at 16.3 s against a body of about -12.5, true peak -1.4 dBFS. Slim margin; a short dip before the drop would sell it. Measured only: a person must listen.

Fixed (template r3): the grid card's footer stamp is set inline, one gap after the text block (endCard stamp: "inline"), and a lockup with a descender declares it (descent 0.3), so the line under 'Tally' keeps its air.
